challenge.results: The first import alias cannot resolve the next import's target. An environment may define implicit imports, and Imports uses a separate resolution rule for its target. Those provisions leave the scope of an individual source-file statement intact.

limitations: Ordinary source-file Imports in the pinned .NET language specification. Environment-generated imports and imported namespace resolution are separate.
